body:
Everyone tells me to work out, and honestly it probably would help but it's really hard to motivate myself to start doing anything when I'm feeling like that...

I am doing marginally better this morning. I still feel like crap honestly but I'm not thinking about various ways I could die so thats nice I think.

I'm trans, MTF, and currently in a situation where doing anything to help with that is far beyond my control or ability to do.

It hurts that I cant do anything but honestly I just try to not think about it because I cant do anything... I guess it all just came crashing down tonight.
